experiment_scope.quantity: time-of-flight detector intensity in arbitrary units

digitization.method: 600-dpi Poppler render; exact Pillow crop; dark-pixel axis localization; plus-marker template scan; original-resolution visual overlay
digitization.transcribed_quantity: time coordinate of the highest measured plus marker in each product panel
digitization.ordinate_policy: do not digitize intensity because the ordinate is unlabelled arbitrary units and common inter-panel gain is not established

full_resolution_visual_inspection.assertion: all three crosshairs are centered on the highest measured plus marker in their respective panels

source_text_cross_checks.sif2_path: substantial thermally activated desorption of a collision-generated precursor
source_text_cross_checks.sif4_path: precursor diffusion followed by desorption; the source describes a roughly 0.5 ms / hundreds-of-microseconds lag

valid: species ordering and approximate measured-peak timing for this one beam condition
a required distinction between prompt collision products and delayed precursor transport
not_valid: a diffusion coefficient or diffusion length
an absolute intensity or cross-panel product yield
an instrument-response-deconvolved surface clock; the trace includes the 100 us beam pulse, flight time, detector geometry, and product velocity distribution
a C4F6-plasma or Krueger-reactor boundary parameter
